text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so the selection panel chose one woman over another. Raising the panel’s gender composition does not support a claim of unlawful sex discrimination and will undermine your credibility. The composition is likely coincidental or a reflection of school leadership demographics. 

If there was unfairness, it would more likely involve age, internal politics, or personal connections rather than sex. Instead of mentioning gender, follow up politely on your request for the written statement. Focus your questions strictly on objective merits, such as your administrative experience, master's degree, and how candidates were scored against the job criteria.
